greet.speaker: Margaret
greet.text: Thursday already. I swept the walk, but that front step still rocks if you catch it wrong.

problem.speaker: Margaret
problem.text: The spare key ring is off its hook. I won't lock the office over a missing ring.

sent_harold.speaker: Margaret
sent_harold.text: He's in the sanctuary, fretting the office lock. Ask him before he orders new hardware.

sent_search.speaker: Margaret
sent_search.text: Try the stacked chairs along the west wall. Harold sets things down and calls it sorted.

busy.speaker: Margaret
busy.text: The ring is still missing. Sanctuary first. I have bulletins to fold.

return_harold.speaker: Margaret
return_harold.text: He told you where they were. Good. I'll put them on the hook, not where Harold calls orderly.

return_search.speaker: Margaret
return_search.text: You found them without a committee. I'll take that. Harold will say he knew all along.

after.speaker: Margaret
after.text: Keys are on the hook. The step still rocks. One problem at a time.
